tests.standards: Testing follows integration-first strategy per CLAUDE.md constitution. Tests mirror production code organization (tests/ops/, tests/assets/, tests/resources/, tests/jobs/). All tests use @pytest.mark.integration markers. IOManager tests use pytest fixtures (io_manager with tmp_path) for isolated execution and Dagster test utilities (OutputContext, InputContext, AssetKey). No doc-strings per project standards. Run `make check` after all changes for format, lint, typecheck, and test validation.
